Subject: Pipeline stretch targets and account surgery

Team —

Attached is a refreshed heatmap and the Acme commit card (v2). After today's ops review we have a ~22% shortfall vs. our regional stretch target for Q4. We need to pick the 6 accounts we can realistically operate on this week for surgical plays (rebundles, exec outreach, procurement unblock).

Asks: 1) Laura — can you confirm stage changes on the attached sheet by EOD today (specifically ACME, Nimbus, HorizonTech)? 2) Marcus — finance needs a short bridge scenario (best / base / conservative) for these 6 accounts so we can model upside into the forecast. 3) Aditya — please stand up a 30-min commit review for Monday (agenda below).

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick heatmap walk (5)
- Owner pledges and stage updates (10)
- Finance bridge scenarios (10)
- Next steps & play ownership (5)

Notes: prioritize accounts where legal/contracting is the only blocker or where exec engagement is likely to convert within the quarter. I've highlighted Acme and HorizonTech in the PDF — both are high conversion potential if we can compress procurement timelines.

Thanks,
Mateo

--

Thanks — I updated the acme-commit-card.xlsx with stage moves and current blockers. Quick summary inline below:

- Acme Corp: moved to Commit-Pending-PO. Legal has final review (ETA 48 hrs). Owner: Mateo.
- Nimbus Analytics: moved to Late-Stage (procurement > contract review). Owner: Priya (not on thread) — outreach scheduled Monday.
- HorizonTech: remains Opportunity (exec alignment ongoing). CTO candor suggests proof-of-concept terms are main blocker.
- FluxMedia, TerroIQ, GridScale: flagged as Pull candidates (low confidence) — recommend deprioritizing for surgical plays.

I'll be available for Monday's commit review; added brief notes on attach column C for each account. Let me know if you want me to call Acme legal directly — I can escalate but need Mateo's sign-off.

Laura

Preliminary bridge scenarios attached here: high-case +$1.2M, base-case +$560k, conservative +$110k for the six accounts under consideration. The numbers assume: Acme closes at 85% of ARR on the PO timeline we discussed; HorizonTech moves to PO with a 60-day POC concession; Nimbus converts but slips revenue into Jan (so we only count a 30% portion this quarter).

Action items for Monday:
- Finance will present model assumptions for each account (5 min)
- Owners (Mateo/Priya) to confirm gating items and whether legal/procurement escalations are accepted as next step (10 min)
